task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find out the number of ways of painting the fence such that at most 2 adjacent posts have the same color for the given fence with n posts and k colors.
specification_response:
method CountWaysToPaintFence(n: int, k: int) returns (ways: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned ways value represents the total number of ways to paint the fence with n posts using k colors
    - No more than two adjacent posts have the same color in the painting arrangement counted
